When setting up Feishu integrations for team workflows, a key gotcha is that bot channel configuration and Feishu document sync are managed in entirely separate admin interfaces. You must navigate to two distinct sections of the admin dashboard to complete setup for tools using both, adding unnecessary steps during onboarding or adjustments. https://fastgpt.io/faq/what-is-inference-speed #llm #devops
